role: Supplementary analysis prespecified before held-out inference; primary protocol and all seven primary model results remain unchanged
weight_rule: uniform arithmetic mean of exported probability vectors; each member has weight 1/3
probability_processing: No fitting, recalibration, clipping, renormalization, threshold tuning or member selection
tie_rule: argmax takes the first class in the published class order
clinical_rule: Only the three multitask AD/CN heads; average already slice-aggregated subject probabilities within each source/split; MCI remains prediction-only
stage_uncertainty: Reuse primary paired bootstrap helper: 2000 context-seeded replicates, base seed 1729, two-sided 95% percentile intervals; prepared hash-group units for primary/sensitivity and image units for reused original100
clinical_uncertainty: Reuse exact Clopper-Pearson intervals for subject accuracy, AD sensitivity and CN specificity; no old-baseline AD/CN comparison
member_spread: Report every member's accuracy, balanced accuracy and macro F1; arithmetic mean, sample SD, minimum and maximum across the three prespecified seeds
disagreement: Any-member hard-prediction disagreement and each of the three pairwise disagreement rates on the same aligned cases; descriptive only
brier: Mean over cases of the SUM over classes of (probability minus one-hot reference)^2; range 0 to 2, not divided by class count
ece: Top-label ECE with ten fixed equal-width bins [0,.1),...,[.9,1]; sum of bin fraction times absolute bin accuracy minus mean maximum probability; empty bins contribute zero
calibration_interpretation: Brier and ECE are descriptive, uncalibrated probability summaries with no added confidence intervals; not clinical calibration evidence or selection criteria
decision_rule: Report both condition ensembles and all applicable cohorts regardless of results; no winner, promotion, deployment or additional training is selected from held-out outcomes
compute: CPU analysis of existing evaluator CSVs only; zero new GPU inference or training
limitations: Ensembling can retain correlated errors and does not fix missing patient provenance, source confounding or inadequate clinical data.
Original100 remains historically reused, and the primary exact-row comparison has known old development hash-group exposure; the secondary subset is not patient-independent.
Conditional bootstrap intervals do not account for training randomness or multiple comparisons; three-seed spread is not a confidence interval.
The clinical external pilot contains only one AD subject. Ensemble averaging does not increase the independent sample size.
Research inference with an ensemble requires three member forwards; no production inference wrapper is built or deployed by this analysis.
